title: Get in touch
intro: Reach out for more information about our Sunday service, Bible studies, prayer gathering, and church life.
cta_text: You don't need to know anyone or bring anything — just come. We're looking forward to connecting with you.
meeting_place: Home gathering off of MLK Pkwy in Durham, NC.
meeting_note: Email us for the exact address and directions — we'll be glad to help you find us.

schedule.title: Sunday Service
schedule.note: Children's service provided. We gather around the Lord's Table and God's Word.

schedule.title: Bible Study
schedule.note: We're open to more Bible study times based on individual needs. We love the Bible!

schedule.title: Prayer Gathering
schedule.note: Seeking the Lord together and praying for one another and for the gospel.
